params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Person_InLaborForce_Male_AsAFractionOf_Count_Person_Male', 'Count_Person_InLaborForce_Female_AsAFractionOf_Count_Person_Female') AND NumPlaces >= 540 AND NumObservations >= 4300 AND CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) <= 2018 AND CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_lfpr_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN StatVar = 'Count_Person_FormalLabor_AsAFractionOf_Count_Person_InLaborForce' AND NumPlaces >= 35 AND NumObservations >= 380 AND CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) <= 2015 AND CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_fl_rows FROM stats
params.condition: total_rows IN (1, 2, 3) AND total_rows = (valid_lfpr_rows + valid_fl_rows) AND valid_lfpr_rows IN (0, 2) AND valid_fl_rows IN (0, 1)
